label: Stefano Fieschi da Soncino
summary: A manual of Latin phrasing, synonyms, and letter composition by Stefano Fieschi.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 11 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Language, Rhetoric and Grammar. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Stefano Frisco da Soncino".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Synonyma sententiarum. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
